registration.sources: approved per-source exact mapping; one canonical unit may have many websites
registration.participation: CP canonical (project,user) participation, frozen ruleVersionId at binding before first fact; one award per participation/reward type across source websites

qualification.ruleVersionId: pinned at participation entry; retiring a version only closes new participation, historical enrolled corrections/revokes remain possible
qualification.facts: source-verified allowlisted fields + evidence reference IDs; never arbitrary script or auto CP endorsement

permissions: existing scoped Programme authorization; no new machine scopes or credentials enabled
actualLiveBoundary: FS previous live command remains blocked; isolated synthetic tests only
credentialIssuer: explicit approved Institution; authorized representation, issuer/class and rule/template snapshot frozen; true PDF required before certificate success
publicDisplay: owner-controlled independent grant visibility; private by default; withdrawal never invalidates underlying fact
currentAdapters: POINTS/BADGE/CERTIFICATE isolated actual PostgreSQL + real PDF tests passed; not live machine onboarding
crossSourceRevocation: one invalid source never revokes award if another accepted valid basis remains
canonicalUnit: projectId is one separately approved rewardable unit/edition, never a whole multi-edition Programme
